# BB00678: Ziyarat for the first [to believe] {.unnumbered}

Visitation for the First [to believe]

In the Name of God, the Most Glorious, the Most Glorious

Verily the glory rest upon thee, O First Temple! Then majesty be upon thee, then beauty be upon thee, then grandeur be upon thee, then light be upon thee, then mercy be upon thee, then the names be upon thee, then might be upon thee, then knowledge be upon thee, then power be upon thee, then good-pleasure be upon thee, then love be upon thee, then honor be upon thee, then sovereignty be upon thee, then dominion be upon thee, then grace be upon thee, then the verses be upon thee, then the words be upon thee, then the manifestations be upon thee, through that which the knowledge of thy Lord hath encompassed from before and after, and His power extendeth over all things in the kingdoms of Command and Creation and what lieth between them. Verily, He is the All-Knowing, the All-Powerful.

In the Name of God, the Most Exalted, the Most Exalted!

All glory be to thee, O Second Temple! [Same blessings repeated]

In the Name of God, the Most Beautiful, the Most Beautiful!

All glory be to thee, O Third Temple! [Same blessings repeated]

In the Name of God, the Most Great, the Most Great!

All glory be to thee, O Fourth Temple! [Same blessings repeated]

In the Name of God, the Most Luminous, the Most Luminous!

All glory be to thee, O Fifth Temple! [Same blessings repeated]

In the Name of God, the Most Merciful, the Most Merciful!

All glory be to thee, O Sixth Temple! [Same blessings repeated]

In the Name of God, the Most Great, the Most Great!

All glory be to thee, O Seventh Temple! [Same blessings repeated]

In the Name of God, the Most Mighty, the Most Mighty!

All glory be to thee, O Eighth Temple! [Same blessings repeated]

In the Name of God, the Most Knowing, the Most Knowing!

All glory be to thee, O Ninth Temple! [Same blessings repeated]

In the Name of God, the Most Powerful, the Most Powerful!

All glory be to thee, O Tenth Temple! [Same blessings repeated]

In the Name of God, the Most Pleasing, the Most Pleasing!

All glory be to thee, O Eleventh Temple! [Same blessings repeated]

In the Name of God, the Most Loving, the Most Loving!

All glory be to thee, O Twelfth Temple! [Same blessings repeated]

In the Name of God, the Most Noble, the Most Noble!

All glory be to thee, O Thireenth Temple! [Same blessings repeated]

In the Name of God, the Most Central, the Most Central!

All glory be to thee, O Fourteenth Temple! [Same blessings repeated]

In the Name of God, the Most Sovereign, the Most Sovereign!

All glory be to thee, O Fifteenth Temple! [Same blessings repeated]

In the Name of God, the Most Ancient, the Most Ancient!

All glory be to thee, O Sixteenth Temple! [Same blessings repeated]

In the Name of God, the Most Generous, the Most Generous!

All glory be to thee, O Seventeenth Temple! [Same blessings repeated]

In the Name of God, the Most Permanent, the Most Permanent!

All glory be unto thee, O Eighteenth Temple! [Same blessings repeated]

In the Name of God, the Most Manifest, the Most Manifest!

All glory be unto thee, O Nineteenth Temple! [Same blessings repeated]

Glorified art Thou, O my God! The proofs of the temples of Thy chosen ones in the Bayan cannot be numbered, nor the like of the circles of Thy handmaidens therein. And verily, as Thou hast taught me and all Thy creation, the First is One, and after that the temples and circles in their most exalted, most impregnable, most holy, and most sovereign states, and what is in them and upon them of the manifestations of Thy names and the revelations of Thine examples, since all things return unto the temple of man. Therefore, O my God, cause all who are in the Bayan whom Thou hast loved to return unto the temple of Him Whom Thou shalt make manifest on the Day of Resurrection, prostrating before Thy face, worshipping Thy Being, devoted to Thy Self, remembering Thy verses, grateful for Thy favors, content with Thy decree, patient in Thy good-pleasure, submissive to Thy Essence, humble before Thy Identity, supplicating the Sovereign of Thy Oneness, exalted through the exaltation of the King of Thy Singleness, lest any temple and its deeds be lost, and that all Thou hast planted may bear fruit to the highest degree possible. Verily, Thou art powerful and mighty over that, and knowing and encompassing all things.
